name: Imouto Sei Gangu ~Lolita Shoujo ni Yaritai Houdai~
original_name: 妹・性玩具～ロリータ少女に犯りたい放題～
source:
The protagonist had feelings for his sister.
One day, their parents decided to go on a trip, leaving the siblings at home.
The two are alone in the house... And the protagonist steps forward to do the forbidden act.

[edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE048951.html]DLsite English[/url]]
